title: Teach Vaporize to emit observable tool-call receipts
createdBy: mono per operator cascade: Vaporize gives insight into tool calling

historicalContent.createdBy: mono per operator cascade: Vaporize gives insight into tool calling
historicalContent.description: Extend Vaporize so build/install/open/run/pass/realize routes can emit ToolCallReceiptModel-compatible evidence. This makes assistant tool calling observable and lets Warehouse aggregate repeated failures, shortcuts, and missing-tool vapor.
acceptanceCriteria: Vaporize can emit a tool-call receipt for pass/build/install/open/run/realize routes.
Tool-call receipts link to VaporwareUnit or WarehouseEntry when present.
Dry-run routes emit planned tool-call receipts without executing destructive work.
Failed calls emit blocked/failed receipts with failureMode instead of disappearing into terminal output.
Receipts preserve compatibility with existing Vaporize pass-through receipts while moving forward to ToolCallReceiptModel v0.0.1.
Vaporize emits CommonLog structured events for tool-call start, allowed-tool dispatch, command/process execution, receipt write, Warehouse write, and failure handling.
Vaporize exposes a shared verbose logging control, preferably through CommonShellArguments, that expands diagnostics without changing receipt truth.
Tool-call receipts include traceId, parentTraceId, logLevel, verboseEnabled, analyticsEventName, analyticsDimensions, durationMs, attemptNumber, and redactionSummary.
Verbose output never becomes the canonical source of truth; typed receipts and Warehouse entries do.
Analytics rollups can be derived from Vaporize receipts without replaying raw command output.
